visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a white t-shirt and a man in a black t-shirt are sitting on a grey couch against a light wood-paneled wall. The man has his hands behind his head, and a television remote lies on the couch next to him. (2) A woman enters from the left wearing a white t-shirt and a white cap with cherry patterns, carrying a large hot dog-shaped plush toy. She positions herself behind the boy while yellow text overlays appear on the screen. (3) The woman performs a repetitive clapping motion with her hands near the boy's head, creating a fake slapping visual. Each time she claps, the man flinches violently, covers his head, and eventually brandishes a long green foam noodle as if defending himself, while the boy sits calmly and smiles at the camera. (4) The woman stops the motion and leans down to hug and nuzzle the boy, who is giggling. The man sits back with the green foam noodle, looking exhausted as the scene fades.
